description: This file is a script for detecting changes in a code repository and determining which parts of the build/test pipeline should run based on changed files. It defines patterns to identify different scopes of changes and provides functions to list changed files, detect scope, and output results for CI workflows.

methods.name: detectChangedScope
methods.description: Analyzes a list of changed paths and determines which parts of the pipeline should be run, returning a scope object with boolean flags.

methods.name: listChangedPaths
methods.description: Executes a git command to list files changed between two commits or references.

methods.name: writeGitHubOutput
methods.description: Writes the scope flags to a GitHub Actions output file to inform subsequent CI steps.
